description: 32 Woodote Road Wallington SM6 0NN Condition 5 Discharge
decision_conditions: The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement prepared by Achieve Green Ltd and dated 21 June 2024. Prior to first occupation of the dwellings, 'as-built' Standard AssessmentProcedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018
